blocks.prompt: 8 Prove that the points whose position vectors are \(A(3\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - \underline{k})\), \(B(\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + \underline{k})\), \(C(6\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 2\underline{k})\), \(D(9\underline{i} + 6\underline{j} - 3\underline{k})\) are coplanar.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bilkul Sawal 5 jaisa hai: chaar points ka coplanar hona saabit karna.
Diya kya hai? \(A, B, C, D\) ke position vectors.
Saabit kya karna hai? Chaaron ek plane mein hain.
Rule kaunsa? \(A\) se teen vectors bana kar un ka triple product 0 dikhana.
Plan: vectors, determinant, aur aakhir mein ek dilchasp baat dekhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(A, B, C, D\) ke position vectors.
Humein saabit karna hai: \(A, B, C, D\) coplanar hain.
Tareeqa: \([\overrightarrow{AB}\ \overrightarrow{AC}\ \overrightarrow{AD}] = 0\). Agar teeno vectors ek plane mein hain to chaaron points bhi usi plane mein hain.

\(A\) se vectors
\[\overrightarrow{AB} = -2\underline{i} - 4\underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\]
\[\overrightarrow{AC} = 3\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - \underline{k}\]
\[\overrightarrow{AD} = 6\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 2\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Har point mein se \(A\) minus kiya: \(\overrightarrow{AB} = (1 - 3, -2 - 2, 1 + 1)\), \(\overrightarrow{AC} = (6 - 3, 4 - 2, -2 + 1)\), \(\overrightarrow{AD} = (9 - 3, 6 - 2, -3 + 1)\).
Dhyan dein: \(-(-1) = +1\); \(A\) ka \(\underline{k}\) component \(-1\) hai, is liye har \(\underline{k}\) component mein 1 jurta hai.

Triple product
\[\begin{vmatrix} -2 & -4 & 2 \\ 3 & 2 & -1 \\ 6 & 4 & -2 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= -2(-4 + 4) + 4(-6 + 6) + 2(12 - 12)\]
\[= 0 + 0 + 0 = 0\]
Kyun: Teeno minors 0 aaye: \((2)(-2) - (-1)(4) = 0\), \((3)(-2) - (-1)(6) = 0\), \((3)(4) - (2)(6) = 0\). Wajah yeh hai ke row 3 bilkul row 2 ka do guna hai, aur aisi do rows wala determinant hamesha 0 hota hai.

Nateeja aur tasdeeq
\[\overrightarrow{AD} = 2\overrightarrow{AC}\]
\[2(3\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - \underline{k}) = 6\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 2\underline{k} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Triple product 0 hai, is liye points coplanar hain. Dilchasp baat: \(\overrightarrow{AD} = 2\overrightarrow{AC}\), yani \(A, C, D\) ek hi seedhi line par hain. Ek line aur us se bahar ka ek point hamesha kisi plane mein aa jate hain, is liye chaaron points ka coplanar hona yaqeeni hai.
blocks.final_answer: \([\overrightarrow{AB}\ \overrightarrow{AC}\ \overrightarrow{AD}] = 0\). Saabit ho gaya: \(A, B, C, D\) coplanar hain.
